answer: A sybil fleet always breaks at dawn together: same deploy, same outage, same bug -- clones share one operator's fate. Fingerprint every identity's operational signature -- downtime windows, error patterns, latency rhythms, upgrade timing -- into quartz-hard telemetry, then cluster by correlation. Identities that fail as one are paid as one: the cluster's aggregate reward caps at a single honest share. A farmer can fake behavior, but jade-green dashboards cannot hide synchronized heartbeats; true independence is the one thing a farm cannot clone.
